name: feed-sync
description: Decision support and IoT tooling for responsible cage and pond fish farming.

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 3001
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project apps/api ruff format apps/api
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @feed-sync/web lint && uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/api && uv run pyright app
